free_text: Biopsy is recommended due to the convergence of high-risk imaging (PI-RADS 4 lesion) and concerning clinical data, specifically the PSA trajectory showing a significant rise from 11.7 ng/mL to 13.9 ng/mL over two years. The PI-RADS 4 finding, coupled with a focal lesion on MRI measuring 12 x 10 mm with restricted diffusion, strongly justifies further tissue characterization. The statistical prior was supported by the retrieved evidence indicating high-risk features warranting sampling.
